response.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) FROM trans WHERE (CASE WHEN LENGTH(CAST(date AS TEXT)) = 6 THEN '19' || CAST(date AS TEXT) ELSE REPLACE(CAST(date AS TEXT), '-', '') END) BETWEEN '19960509' AND '19980106' AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ');
